posts.headline: Google's Genie 4 builds worlds you can steer live
posts.hook: Google just built AI worlds you can steer live!
posts.caption:
Google's new Genie 4 world model builds AI worlds you can steer and change in real time. The Google DeepMind model adds matching audio, from music to dialogue, and keeps a scene consistent for up to two minutes, double Genie 3. It's in research preview for trusted testers now, with Google AI Ultra subscribers next.

Source: TechCrunch, https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/27/googles-genie-4-world-model-adds-audio-more-realistic-worlds-and-real-time-steering/

posts.headline: Anthropic, the maker of Claude, files to go public
posts.hook: Claude's maker just filed to go public!
posts.caption:
Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, has filed for an IPO and plans to list on the stock market under the ticker ANT. Its filing shows $16.3 billion in revenue for the first half of 2026, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier, while its seven co-founders will keep control of 50.1% of the voting power.

Source: TechCrunch, https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/26/anthropic-officially-files-for-its-public-debut/

posts.headline: Singapore pitches a global AI incident reporting pilot
posts.hook: Singapore wants AI incidents shared like airline near misses!
posts.caption:
Singapore's Prime Minister Lawrence Wong has proposed an AI incident reporting pilot, where countries would agree on common incident categories and share information securely to make AI safer. He pointed to aviation, where incidents and near misses are reported and studied so safety keeps improving. He made the pitch at an October 28 online meeting on frontier AI safety with leaders from 31 countries.

Source: The Straits Times, https://www.straitstimes.com/tech/singapore-proposes-ai-incident-reporting-pilot-to-boost-ai-safety

posts.headline: Tesla starts early production of Optimus humanoid robots
posts.hook: Tesla has started building its Optimus humanoid robots!
posts.caption:
Tesla has started building Optimus humanoid robots 🤖

On Tesla's earnings call last week, Elon Musk said early production has begun on the company's high-volume line in Fremont, California. He also said the hands, safety, reliability, durability and AI still need work. Musk expects Tesla could start delivering Optimus to outside companies around the end of 2027.

Follow @okugroup for daily AI & robotics news.

Source: The Verge, https://www.theverge.com/tech/1016492/tesla-optimus-robots-production-musk-q3-earnings
